subject: [PATCH v5 11/22] erofs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations in the erofs file system to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using macros that wrap the iomap_iter_next() helper. This change does not introduce any functional changes and is a conversion to the new API. The affected files are data.c and zmap.c.
